About Hands & Homes

Good help should bring peace of mind.

We are a trusted domestic staffing and household support company helping families find dependable professionals. Every introduction is thoughtful, transparent and built around lasting trust.

From first conversation to post-placement support, our team stays close—because the right fit changes more than a routine. It changes how home feels.

Frequently asked questions

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Still unsure? We’re happy to talk it through.

Email our team →
How do I request a staff member?

Complete the request form with your location, preferred role and schedule. Our team will contact you to clarify the brief and next steps.

How are staff members screened?

We verify identity and documentation, conduct interviews, check references and previous employment, and assess relevant skills.

Can I interview a staff member before hiring?

Yes. Interviews are an important part of making a confident final selection.

What types of domestic staff are available?

Housekeepers, cooks, nannies, caregivers, drivers, cleaners, laundry staff and personal assistants.

Do you provide temporary and permanent staff?

Yes. Availability varies, but we support temporary, part-time, permanent, live-in and live-out arrangements.

What happens if the staff member is not a good fit?

Contact us promptly so we can review the situation and explain any replacement assistance available under your placement terms.

How long does recruitment take?

Timing depends on the role and requirements. We communicate realistic expectations after reviewing your request.

Do you offer replacement assistance?

Replacement terms depend on the agreed service package and will be provided clearly before placement.
